added: When a later version of the app comes with a figure named like one of your new figures, the figure's Glossary page offers Rename mine, or Switch to the app's: you choose what each of your parameters and options becomes in the app's figure, then, after a confirmation that counts the dances using yours, those dances, your default figures and your shorthands use the app's figure instead, with the same beats, and yours is removed.
